weighting.rule: Target-only16groups x8actions x12focalmovements have unit mean row weight; mixed arms keep totalmass1536 with source/target768each, equal groups/actions/movements within each side. Same hyperparameters do not imply identical bins or leaf support.

analysis.primary_metric: Mean absolute error of predicted candidate-minus-PP response contrasts; equal seven nonPP actions, focal movements and two outputs, then equal two groups within each target seed, then equal ten seeds.
analysis.gate: Source minus each comparator paired seed-bootstrap95upper<0 AND each source single-output contrast MAE<=target-only. All conditions conjunctive; exploratory development, no winner/threshold reselection.
analysis.secondary: Report per-output contrast error, raw-count error, all heldout seed/case results and unphysical predicted receipt>initial_internal+entry counts; no posthoc projection.

roster_rule: Source eight spatially alternating TLS, target row-major twelve TLS round-robin; first native eight-action epoch at anchor..anchor+60. No traffic/outcome filtering. Two anchors per seed and firstPP included in eight branches.
seed_scope: New development seeds absent from local experiment/config JSON before this roster. Measurement pilot seeds excluded; not independent confirmation.
feature_rule: Fixed838 graph features, no city/TLS/action identifiers as predictors. Relations overlap; supply deduplicated per relation/service lane set, never allocated across turns. Current observations, geometry, executor and ten-step nominal signals only.
collection_gate: All28groups/224branches complete, direct t0 input/geometry/conflicts/event accounting valid, native starts/candidates identical, no prefix or branch collisions/teleports. Exact nominal match OR actual timeline reproduced by nominal transition plus observed clearance occupancy according to the unchanged safe executor. Future observations used solely for execution audit, never as predictors.
failure: First invalid group stops that seed shard. All shards are submitted as one fixed batch; already submitted shards finish their bounded work. Any incomplete group holds all fitting.
coverage_rule: Before any fit or reading new labels for analysis, review only all frozen t0 group and movement supply (vehicles,halted,near-stopline proxy). If source remains predominantly low-queue and cannot inform the target queue regime, HOLD_SOURCE_COVERAGE. Judge the actual group and movement distributions; no scores, outcome filters, demand tuning, seed/state replacement or weight search.
fit_gate: Separate coverage_decision.json must authorize PASS_SOURCE_COVERAGE for the exact28case roster. No fitting on pilot.30fixed fits only after complete collection and coverage review.
boundary: Alpha/beta and old HOLD_RESPONSE unchanged. No cost readout, no closed loop, no post-result model/threshold reselection.

measurement_amendment.reason: Nominal plan intentionally omits future occupancy extensions; requiring exact actual equality incorrectly rejects valid clearance-controlled branches and excludes slow-clearing states.
measurement_amendment.retained: All original seeds,states,features,model,weights,labels and statistical gates; v1 HOLD preserved separately.
measurement_amendment.completion: Reuse all recorded branches and run only never-executed branches; total224 budget unchanged.
